reason: The cited evidence (E1-E3) shows that nano-twins are induced in SLM CoCrFeNiMn during fatigue and contribute to plasticity, but it does not demonstrate that laser surface remelting creates a nano-twin-rich layer or that such a layer improves hardness, wear, and fatigue resistance. The key premises about the intervention's effect and the resulting property improvements are unsupported by the provided passages.
premises: Laser surface remelting of SLM CoCrFeNiMn can produce a uniform, nano-twin-rich surface layer
Nano-twin boundaries serve as effective barriers to dislocation motion, enhancing hardness, wear resistance, and fatigue life
The remelting process refines the surface microstructure and generates nano-twin boundaries
The treated surface will exhibit significantly higher microhardness, reduced wear rate, and increased fatigue resistance compared to untreated SLM components
